title: Domain sales Test lets the Founder in; Edit no longer opens the privacy card
why: Jason, 2026-11-17, after choosing Test for Domain sales: "Saved, but Shop → Domains isn't open for you yet: Buying a domain through Traversence opens soon", and the privacy choices card popped up. (1) Test mode lets in only our team, but its check (Market::isStaff) counted only admin_access rows, so the Founder's admin login (is_admin) wasn't counted. Domains::isTeam now counts our team as the admin side's sign-in does (TwoStep::isStaff: is_admin, admin_access, an admin role grant), for Domain sales and for Own domains on storefronts alike. (2) Release #73's Edit buttons carried data-choices, which js/consent.js treats as 'open the privacy card' on any click; renamed data-env-choices.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
